notes: General evaluative dimension, not specific foundation.
Woke relates to caring for marginalized and fairness/justice.
Hippie: care (peace) and liberty (anti-authority); militaristic: authority.
Gluttony is a purity vice; moderate is a purity virtue (self-discipline).
Good manners relate to respect (authority) and general virtue.
Delicate suggests refinement (purity virtue); coarse suggests lack of refinement.
